text:
lara (AE): Hey team — Qnexus Health asked for a short POC to validate throughput/latency for their EHR summarization flow. Goal: 150 concurrent requests, p95 < 250ms, <1% error rate. Can we run an initial stress test tomorrow?

nisha (Sales Eng): Thanks — a few clarifying q's: avg input tokens ~420, max 1k. Response length ~120 tokens. Which model variant are we using for POC (fp16/8-bit)? Also do they need streaming?

lara (AE): They prefer non-streaming batched responses. Open to 8-bit quantized if quality OK.

jin (SRE): I'll draft a load plan. Assuming batch size 8, target qps ~= 150 (concurrency == concurrent in their infra). Plan: warmup 5m, ramp to load over 3m, 15m steady, 5m cooldown. Collect p50/p95/p99, GPU util, OOMs, error codes.

nisha (Sales Eng): +1. Add KV cache disabled (requests are unique). Also capture token counts and tail-latency per sequence-length bucket.

sam (Customer Eng): We'll need a security note: tests will use synthetic PHI-like text. Make sure logs scrubbed and test data not persisted in console.

deploy-bot: Deployed model "rwd-llama-2-13b-q8" to staging-cluster-a (zone us-east-1) at sha: ab12c3f. GPUs: A100-80GB x4. Endpoint: https://staging-infer.redwood/qnexus-poc

jin (SRE): Test harness (example):
```
# run using rwd-load (internal)
rwd-load --endpoint https://staging-infer.redwood/qnexus-poc \n  --concurrency 150 --duration 00:23:00 --batch-size 8 \n  --payload-file tests/fixtures/qnexus_ehr_420.json \n  --metrics-output s3://redwood-testlogs/qnexus/1852109876/metrics.json
```
Collecting GPU metrics with nvidia-smi/top on each node and tracing request ids.

nisha (Sales Eng): Can we also try a cheaper config (gapped quant) for cost estimate? If 8-bit misses quality, we want fallback to fp16, with measured delta.

jin (SRE): Will run 3 runs: q8, fp16, q8+gapped. Schedule: tomorrow 09:00 UTC. I'll post results here.

-- (later, after run) --

jin (SRE): Run finished. Quick summary below, full logs in S3.

nisha (Sales Eng): results pls :)

jin (SRE): q8 (primary): duration 15m steady
```
qps: 148
p50: 92ms
p95: 238ms
p99: 410ms
error_rate: 0.6% (mostly 429 retries)
GPU util (avg): 78%
mem headroom: 9GB per GPU
```

jin (SRE): fp16 (fallback):
```
qps: 150
p50: 88ms
p95: 210ms
p99: 360ms
error_rate: 0.2%
GPU util: 85%
```

jin (SRE): q8+gapped (cheaper profile):
```
qps: 146
p50: 95ms
p95: 260ms
error_rate: 1.1% (higher due to small batching jitter)
GPU util: 70%
```

sam (Customer Eng): Looks solid — q8 meets p95 target (238ms) but error rate close to 1%. We should lower retry window or bump dedicated capacity to avoid 429s in steady state.

nisha (Sales Eng): Good. Can you also attach per-length bucket for p95? We promised that to Qnexus.

jin (SRE): Uploaded bucketed latencies + request traces: s3://redwood-testlogs/qnexus/1852109876/buckets.csv
Summary: sequences <500 tokens: p95 190ms; 500-800: p95 260ms; >800: p95 420ms.

lara (AE): Qnexus asked for cost delta between q8 and fp16 at their expected monthly volume (1.2M requests). Any back-of-envelope?

nisha (Sales Eng): Rough calc: q8 ~ 0.7x token-cost of fp16. For their volume that's ~30% cost savings on inference compute, but add potential SLO risk. I'll draft numbers for the deck.

sam (Customer Eng): Security note: jin, confirm test logs scrubbed of PHI and that S3 bucket is private and expires after 30 days per agreement.

jin (SRE): Confirmed: logs scrubbed, bucket ACL private, lifecycle rule 30d delete.

lara (AE): Next steps: share this thread + S3 artifacts with Qnexus tomorrow, propose 2-week canary on Dedicated with fp16 and q8 fallback, include cost spreadsheet. nisha will send pricing options.

nisha (Sales Eng): I'll prepare pricing + risk tradeoffs doc by EOD.

lara (AE): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Archived test run artifacts to s3://redwood-testlogs/qnexus/1852109876/ (retention:30d)
